name: MeetStream — Save completed transcripts to HubSpot

parameters.content:
## Production setup
Connect MeetStream + HubSpot credentials and put this webhook behind a gateway that verifies MeetStream's workspace-webhook signature and rate-limits requests. Forward only verified POST requests here. Set `custom_attributes.hubspot_contact_id` when creating each bot.

MeetStream delivery is best-effort, so monitor failed n8n executions and retry them from n8n.
